props.$comment: sway: top-of-sprite lean in px at full wind (0 or absent = rigid); swayPush: tall grass leaning away from a passing player; light: a light the renderer adds at the prop (src/engine/Lighting.js: radius px, intensity 0..1, color, flicker 0..1, pulse { speed rad/s, depth 0..1 }, glow 0..1 additive colour, zoneBoost x anomaly strength)

swayPush.$comment: extra lean px away from a player within radius px

world.$comment: WorldState (src/world/WorldState.js): tide clock, day/night and weather. Seconds are real seconds.

tide.$startPhase: 0 = low water, 0.5 = high water. 0.7 = falling past mid-tide (height 0.65): the reef tip starts to emerge within the first minute and low water comes 108 s into a new game

day.$lengthSeconds: 13 minutes = 2.17 tide cycles: low water comes about 1.8 in-game hours later each day, so it drifts through day and night over successive days (720 s would pin it to the same hours); 25-40 minute runs last 2-3 days

visibility.$comment: src/world/visibility.js ambientVisibility: sight-range factor; night = moonless clear night, moonGain per unit of world.moonlight

weather.$firstSquallSeconds: fixed, so a new game's sky never depends on the seed; the first squall arrives after the first low water
weather.$squallSeconds: about one squall every 6-7 minutes (two per in-game day), raining a quarter of the time

lighting.$comment: src/engine/Lighting.js (presentation). ambient: keyframes by hour, linearly interpolated (colour and darkness = alpha of the tint layer); colours from assets/src/palette.gpl. moonLift: darkness removed per unit of world.moonlight. storm: blended in by world.weatherIntensity. resolution: lighting canvas size as a fraction of the logical view; smooth: scale it up with smoothing.

player.$comment: the small awareness light that keeps the character visible at night

weatherFx.$comment: src/engine/WeatherFx.js (presentation): rain in screen space, counts at full squall intensity; speeds in logical px/s

water.$comment: src/world/water.js depth classes from tide height h and a tile's flood threshold t: flooded (h > t) is shallow (wading) until h - t >= deepMargin, then deep (swimming); not flooded but t - h <= wetMargin is wet (about to flood or just drained). frameMs: water animation fallback when the sheet has no tag.

inventory.$comment: src/entities/Inventory.js: the 6-slot hotbar is the whole inventory (spec §6.4). startingKit: what a new game carries. dropLongPressMs: holding a hotbar slot this long on touch drops its stack.

interaction.$comment: src/entities/Interactable.js. radius: world px from the player within which each action can be used (default for the rest). aimPickRadius: a click or tap within this of an in-range interactable picks it. spring: drinking channel length and hydration per second. gridCell: bucket size of the spatial lookup.

throw.$comment: src/entities/Projectile.js, thrown distractions (spec §3.2, §6.1). speed px/s; maxRange px (aim points beyond are clamped); defaultDistance: a throw without an aim point, in the facing direction; minAimDistance: a coconut (which is drunk on use) is thrown only when aimed at least this far; arcHeight: drawn peak height per px of distance, capped at maxArcHeight; impactNoise: radius of the landing noise when tuning.noise.throwImpact is absent (spec: 220); radius: body of a landed item for the free-spot search; marchStep/backoff/landSearch px: line-of-sight sampling, step back from an obstacle, search for a free spot.

audit.$comment: The map audit (tools/audit/map.mjs, TASKS.md V2). Tools only: the game never reads this block. Distances in world px, times in s, areas in tiles.
audit.$reachRadius: an entity counts as reached when a cell the player can stand on is within this many px of it
audit.$tideGatedRegions: things here (and on any ground that floods) may be cut off at high tide; everything must still be walkable at low tide
audit.$seaMarkers: places out at sea, checked by the boat route instead of on foot
audit.$anchors: with the region anchors: every pair must be joined by two routes that share no tile (a patrol can never wall the player in); other places with a single way in are listed as warnings
audit.$chokeWidthTiles: min-cut widths are measured up to this many tiles; narrower borders and legs are listed
audit.$significantChokeTiles: a width-1 chokepoint matters when it cuts off at least this much walkable area

swimGate.$margin: at high tide the shortest unbroken swim to the target must exceed margin x a full stamina bar of swimming

provisional.$comment: PROVISIONAL until step 3.1 / 3.3 / 4.1 land: the audit reads tuning.stamina { max, swimDrainPerSecond }, tuning.hydration { max, decayPerSecond, staminaCapBelow } and tuning.ai.patrolSpeed when they exist and falls back to these. Stamina numbers are those of the step 3.1 branch (100 / 2.5 = 40 s of swimming per bar).

hydration.$decayPerSecond: the player agent's figures: thirst caps stamina after ~9.7 min (70 / 0.12 = 583 s) and empties at ~13.9 min
